messages:
maya: Quick sync — consolidating postmortem follow-ups for regional failover. Need owners + timelines for: multi-region routing, backups, restore runbooks, and game-day tests. I'll kick things off, please confirm ownership.

sasha: I can own multi-region routing changes. Plan: update traffic manager policy to prefer primary region until capacity <30% then trigger failover. Will open PR with config + tests by 2026-03-31. Need a QA cluster and a couple of synthetic tests.

ryan: I'll own backups/snapshot audit. Today I'll run an inventory of snapshot cadence and retention across shards. Proposal: full daily snapshots for EU shards for 2 weeks of testing, then reassess. ETA: 2 weeks. Blocker: temporary storage bump (finance signoff).

alex: I will take restore runbooks and verification checklists. I created a draft in Confluence: https://redwood.atlassian.net/restore-runbooks — aim to add step-by-step restore commands + post-restore validation. Suggest we schedule a restore game day in 2 weeks.

maya: Can we avoid overlapping game days across regions? Suggest windows: APAC week of 2026-04-10, EU week of 2026-04-17, NA week of 2026-04-24. @jean @lin pls confirm availability.

jean: EU window works for me. I'll coordinate SRE rotation and reserve capacity. I'll also add an emergency contact list to the runbook (pager, phone, backup oncall).

lin: NA window is fine. Suggest adding a 'fail routing' dry-run: toggle route policy and confirm fallback to secondary region + model-variant fallback. Quick script to simulate routing failure:
```bash
# simulate primary region outage (dev-only)
curl -X POST https://infra-api.internal/simulate-fail -d '{"region":"us-west-2","mode":"routing"}' 
```
We should also verify that KV caches repopulate within expected window.

ops-bot: Automated reminder scheduled — game-day invites will be sent 7 days before each window.

sasha: Routing PR will include: metric gating for cascading latencies, auto-fallback to compatible model variants, and a new SLI for failover success rate (proposal: 99%). Will attach the SLI definition to the PR.

ryan: Finance approved a temporary storage increase for EU snapshot testing for two weeks. We have the quota to run the daily full snapshots. Confirmed.

alex: Added a concrete restore command snippet to the runbook for EU shards: ```bash
restore --from-s3 s3://redwood-backups/eu/2026-03-15 --apply-migrations --verify-checksum
```
Also added a section on 'post-restore traffic gating' to avoid flash traffic.

maya: I'll create a single action tracker (owner / due date / status / notes) in a shared sheet and ping owners weekly. I'll post the tracker link here once it's ready. Owners — please update status by EOD Friday.

jean: I'll run a pre-game health-check checklist (disk, latency baselines, pod counts, infra alarms) and paste results into this thread before each game day.

lin: Note on recurring incident pattern: we've observed regionally correlated CPU spikes during model warmups that cause autoscaler jitter and sometimes failover cascades. Mitigation: add staggered warmup and reserve buffer to autoscaler.

sasha: :thumbsup: Adding warmup stagger + buffer to the routing PR and autoscaler config.

ryan: Reminder: restore test must include KV cache warmup verification and validation of inference latency at 95/99th percentiles. Add a synthetic workload to the game-day script.

alex: Game-day runbook draft is ready for review. I put it in the Confluence page and added a short checklist. Ping me for edits — will iterate quickly.

maya: Thanks everyone. Summary action items: 1) Routing owner: sasha — PR by 2026-03-31. 2) Backups audit + EU snapshot test: ryan — 2 weeks. 3) Restore runbook + game day draft: alex — draft ready, finalize before game day. 4) Pre-game health checks: jean. 5) NA warmup/scale changes: lin. I'll circulate the tracker and set a reconvene for next Tue 10:00 PT. :calendar:
